title: The Villager Who Sold The World
description: I got a bit bored and gave the Weaponsmith a new fit to look like Venom Snake's appearance in Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain.
body:
I don't know why I thought this was a good idea, but now you can turn the Weaponsmith villager into Venom Snake from Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain.

_This texture pack works for both the Villager and Zombie Villager, and is only a texture replacement._
